pr_title: Feature: Added support for choosing the dual pane orientation
pr_body:
### Resolved / Related Issues

- Closes #12427

### Steps used to test these changes

- Check for splitting
  1. Click the Tab Actions button
  2. Click 'Split pane'
  3. Add pane in both ways
- Check for arranging
  1. Click the Tab Actions button
  2. Click 'Arrange pane'
  3. Arrange panes in both ways
- Check for the saved arrangement of panes
  1. Arrange panes vertically
  2. Close the window
  3. Re-open
- Check for the setting to open dual pane always
  1. Select Horizontal/Vertical
  2. Open a new tab
  3. Open a new pane
pr_comments:
@yaira2 because the text `ShowTabActions` has `button` and the control type of `ToggleSwitch` is `button` thus the text includes the control type name, the AXE test is failing. Could you consider text that doesn't include `button`?

![image](https://github.com/files-community/Files/assets/62196528/05f7e4c7-b198-452c-a809-da5c78908ff5)

---

Two to-do is remaining.

1. The “Open in secondary pane” action opens an additional pane even when two panes are already opened. The desired behavior is to replace the content in the other pane (we can display a prompt to confirm that the user wants to do this).
2. “Continue where you left off” doesn’t restore with the correct arrangement.
3. The cursor for the gripper doesn’t update after changing the arrangement.
4. If one tab is arranged vertically and the other horizontally, the arrangement menu doesn’t update when switching between tabs.

> 4. If one tab is arranged vertically and the other horizontally, the arrangement menu doesn’t update when switching between tabs.

Can you ever be in a situation where two tabs are open in different arrangements?

1. Suppressed by preventing opening more than 2 panes.
2. I cannot repro.
3. Fixed.
4. Fixed.
All the issues I reported (including the second one) are resolved.

issue_context.title: Feature: Support choosing the dual pane orientation
issue_context.body:
### What feature or improvement do you think would benefit Files?

The current and vertical panels (one next to the other) are very cool, but they have a problem of poor use of the screen on large screens, especially when using the column layout!
It could still exist, but it would be great to have another option for horizontal panels (one on top of the other), this would be perfect for being able to visualize a whole hierarchy of columns on both sides!

[actual problem]
![image](https://github.com/files-community/Files/assets/25182245/b8b510aa-a76a-4b1b-9f8c-2f973e185c3f)

[concept solution]
![image](https://github.com/files-community/Files/assets/25182245/c95a0fa1-409b-44d5-a2c6-4660990d2e86)



### Requirements

- keep current dashboards for those who prefer
- add a new option to view panels one above the other instead of next to each other

### Files Version

2.4.71.0

### Windows Version

Windows 11 22h2 22621.1702

### Comments

_No response_
